common.loadError: Couldn't load this chapter. Check your connection.

home.promise: Tell us which chapter you're in and see only what you can't miss up to there.

where.title: Where am I?
where.intro: Chapters after yours stay locked, so nothing ahead is shown.
where.confirmAdvance: Move to {{chapter}}? Its items will be shown.
where.leftBehindHint: Their deadline ends before that chapter. Tick off any you already did.

checklist.empty: Nothing to track in this chapter yet.
checklist.allHidden: Nothing left to show with these filters.
checklist.leftBehindHint: Their deadline has passed. If you did them anyway, tick them off.
checklist.allClear: No point of no return with pending items. All caught up!
checklist.carried: Still doable: {{count}} item(s) from earlier chapters
checklist.carriedHint: Their deadline is in this chapter or later.

item.hidden: Hidden until you reveal the name

transfer.title: Move your progress
transfer.intro: Progress lives only on this device. Export a file to back it up or open it on another phone.
transfer.confirm: Replace the progress on this device with the file?

error.wrong-format: That file isn't an exported progress file.
error.wrong-game: That file is for another game.
error.newer-version: That file comes from a newer version of the app. Reload and try again.

credits.title: Credits
credits.sourcesIntro: Facts were checked against these guides and rewritten in our own words. Thank you to their authors.
credits.supportIntro: This project is free and open source, funded only by donations. Nothing is locked behind them.
credits.licensesText: Code under MIT. Game data and community texts under CC BY-SA 4.0.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.progress: Your progress is stored only in this browser. We never receive it.
privacy.analytics: Analytics are cookieless and aggregate (page views and a few anonymous events). No item ids and no personal data.
privacy.suggestions: When suggestions are enabled, we will keep only the text you send, an optional nickname and a one-way hash of your IP address to limit spam.

boss.sectionHint: Names and strategies stay hidden until you reveal them. Not counted in progress.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Only what the chapters you have reached reveal. Spots and dishes from later regions appear as you advance.
collections.fishHint: Best spots first. The rank shown is the best one known so far.
collections.noFish: No fishing yet in the chapters you have reached.
collections.recipesHint: Eat a dish (or cook it) to learn the recipe.
